commands.command: Run an objective-only sanity check on the M151 capability-belief dataset without changing actor inputs or starting PPO.
commands.name: m152_capability_belief_objective_sanity

decision_rule: Only admit capability-belief training toward actor work if objective-only optimization reduces capability target loss while preserving the current human-view actor input contract.
failure_criteria: objective uses hidden parameters as deployable actor inputs
objective optimizes direct mu prediction as the primary target
sanity result is single-seed only or lacks before/after loss reporting
hypothesis: A capability-belief auxiliary objective can learn P0-close future-envelope distinctions from deployable P0 history better than direct friction prediction or passive input expansion.
success_criteria: consume the M151 multiseed capability-belief dataset
report before/after capability target loss across at least three optimization seeds
verify student inputs remain P0 deployable history only
separate losses for braking, yaw, lateral, and pairwise delta targets
record whether the objective is ready for a guarded actor/hidden-state integration test
